label: About
title: About The Color Slips Sideways
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 29 recent saved-signal files and 1 captured links, then narrowed the page to 1 source windows around @gucci4mycat: Praise the lord. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became The Color Slips Sideways: Full-bleed landscape: a blue face fragment beneath a huge red-and-gold crown faces a smaller haloed pink smile across turquoise space. White oval eyes, dot pupils and red crescent smile remain clear. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 1 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Contiguous red-and-gold crown, blue smiling face, and white veil grouping and White-veiled blue smiling face beneath a red-and-gold crown.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
